name: exposed_record
description: In the GET /api/products/:p_productkey endpoint, the query at `result := db.Table("product").Select(...).Where("p_productkey = ?", pProductkey).Take(&row)` fetches a product by primary key without filtering on `p_status`. Since the POST /api/products/:p_productkey/discontinue endpoint updates `p_status` to "discontinued", a discontinued product will still be returned by the GET endpoint as if it were active and purchasable.
